input.quote: 21.3 Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable to any other Party in contract, tort, (including negligence or breach of statutory duty) or otherwise for loss (whether direct or indirect) of profits, property, traffic, business or anticipated savings, or for any indirect or consequential loss or damage in connection with the operation of this Agreement howsoever caused.
input.rationale: Paragraph 21 contains the only liability architecture: 21.1 makes liability several and not joint, 21.2 is a mutual third-party indemnity limited to each Party's Schedule B share, and 21.3 mutually excludes indirect/consequential and certain direct losses. There is no aggregate monetary cap anywhere in the Agreement, so each Party's (including our) direct liability is unlimited, and there are no express carve-outs. That fails the fallback on two material terms (no mutual cap based on 12 months of fees; no uncapped carve-outs), so we target the fallback with one new Subparagraph 21.4 rather than rewriting the section. Because this consortium agreement has no "fees", the cap is expressed on its actual payment stream — the defined Capital Costs and O&M Costs payable in the twelve months preceding the claim. The existing mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages (a preferred-level element) is already in place at 21.3 and is left untouched; we have not pursued the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, data-protection, fraud or IP carve-outs.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual 12-month cost-based aggregate liability cap in Paragraph 21 with uncapped carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 21 excludes indirect loss but sets no aggregate cap, so each Party's direct exposure is unlimited; we added a mutual cap at twelve months of amounts payable under the Agreement, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct left outside the cap.

ops.text: Except for a Party's indemnification obligations, its breach of Paragraph 31 (Confidentiality), its gross negligence or its wilful misconduct, in respect of which no limit shall apply, each Party's aggregate liability to the other Parties arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Capital Costs and O&M Costs paid or payable by that Party under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
